commands.name: test
commands.description: Execute the effective workflow partition manifest and write terminal receipts.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Repository workspace path. [default: <path>]

options.name: --run-root
options.description: Portable affected-tests run root produced by the plan/build stages.

options.name: --partition
options.description: Optional exact partition for a CI matrix job. Omit to run every partition locally.

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description: Maximum concurrent partitions in local all-partitions mode. A positive count or `auto` (reuses the plan's recorded test slots). `auto` sizes it from this job's share of host CPU and free memory (ETP_TEST_SLOT_CORES, _MEMORY_MB, _MIN, _MAX; EAC_CI_TEST_SLOT_* aliases; *_VAR repository variables). Omitted, the host-aware build-session default.

options.name: --module-root
options.description: Optional transported prebuilt-module root.

options.name: --test-environment
options.description: Repeatable NAME=VALUE mapping for test processes; {workspace} expands to ETP_WORKSPACE. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --partition-settings
options.description: Override recorded partition settings for test execution.

options.name: --no-partition-settings
options.description: Disable partition settings discovery for test execution. [default: False]

options.name: --build-lease-timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for a busy local build root before failing with local-build-root-busy (default 600).

options.name: --max-failures
options.description: Opt-in fail-fast: after this many failed test fragments, start no new fragment and stop the running ones (their process trees are terminated). The run fails as stopped early. Counted across the partitions of this invocation; separate --partition processes count independently.

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: Shorthand for --max-failures 1. [default: False]

options.name: --retry-failed-fragments
options.description: Opt in to one isolated, serial retry pass over failed test fragments (0 or 1). [default: 0]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output mode: default (today's output) or agent (one bounded JSON summary on stdout; events go to a file). [default: default]

options.name: --test-slot-cores
options.description: Automatic test slots: logical processors per slot (default 1.5; ETP_TEST_SLOT_CORES).

options.name: --test-slot-memory-mb
options.description: Automatic test slots: free memory per slot in MB (default 1536; ETP_TEST_SLOT_MEMORY_MB).

options.name: --test-slot-min
options.description: Automatic test slots: minimum count (default 4; ETP_TEST_SLOT_MIN).

options.name: --test-slot-max
options.description: Automatic test slots: maximum count (default 12; ETP_TEST_SLOT_MAX).

commands.name: finalize
commands.description: Validate build/test coverage and write the terminal workflow receipt.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Repository workspace path. [default: <path>]

options.name: --run-root
options.description: Portable affected-tests run root to finalize.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Write the human-readable summary instead of the full JSON receipt. [default: False]

options.name: --reuse-preparation
options.description: Verified native green-tree preparation whose test evidence replaces local test execution.

options.name: --upstream-failure
options.description: Name of a CI step that failed between build and test. Used only when tests never started: it names the step in the diagnosis and receipt, and never changes the status. Blank means none.

options.name: --build-lease-timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for a busy local build root before failing with local-build-root-busy (default 600).

options.name: --defer-publication
options.description: Write a resumable publication intent after certification. [default: False]

options.name: --require-clean-workspace
options.description: Fail (affected-tests-workspace-changed) when the repository has tracked or untracked non-ignored changes outside the roots this run owns. Opt-in: local runs may edit the tree. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output mode: default (today's output) or agent (one bounded JSON summary on stdout; events go to a file). [default: default]
